assets.prompt: Edit this laboratory image into a DEPTH-ONLY background layer. CRITICAL CHANGE: remove ALL of the shiny floor which currently occupies bottom third. Extend the rear wall vertically down to the bottom image edge with lower pipes, base panels and recessed dark service duct wall. The camera should face the wall squarely like an architectural front elevation, not looking down at a floor. There must be ZERO visible horizontal floor surface, no near foreground, no characters or animated machinery. The final image is a vertical rear environment to sit BEHIND a separately supplied playable floor. 1536x1024 opaque native PNG. Keep upper clear openings and distant wall depth, no extra apparatus in the empty life zones.
